classification.difficultyReason: Scaffolded: cosine rule for the diagonal, cosine rule for an angle, then two SAS areas.

content.prompt: A paddock $ABCD$ is divided by a fence along $AC$, as shown.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the length of the fence $AC$, correct to the nearest metre.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the size of $\angle ADC$, correct to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
Using the unrounded value of $AC$:
$$\begin{align*}\cos\angle ADC&=\frac{70^2+96^2-AC^2}{2(70)(96)}\\\cos\angle ADC&\approx\frac{6600.7}{13440}\\\angle ADC&\approx61^\circ\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the area of the paddock, correct to the nearest square metre.

answer.worked:
Using the unrounded angle $\angle ADC$:
$$\begin{align*}A_{ABC}&=\frac12(80)(60)\sin75^\circ\\A_{ACD}&=\frac12(70)(96)\sin\angle ADC\\A_{\text{paddock}}&=A_{ABC}+A_{ACD}\\A_{\text{paddock}}&\approx2318+2927\\A_{\text{paddock}}&\approx5245\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
